paper_title: Ultralight vector dark matter search using data from the KAGRA O3GK run
notes: Paper presents a search for U(1)_{B-L} gauge boson dark matter using KAGRA O3GK auxiliary length channel data, yielding upper bounds on the B-L coupling strength g_BL vs mass (target mass range ~1e-14 to 1e-11 eV).
